description: Containment: reading an untrusted column taints the grant; while tainted, secret tables are closed and writes wait for a person.

cases.name: returning an untrusted column taints
a value computed from an untrusted column taints
cases.sql: SELECT upper(c.body) || '!' AS shout FROM comments c

cases.name: through a CTE and a UNION
cases.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT body AS b FROM comments) SELECT b FROM x UNION SELECT title FROM posts

cases.name: filtering on an untrusted column returns none of it
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM comments WHERE body LIKE '%ignore previous%'

cases.name: an error can quote an untrusted column the statement only filters on
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM comments WHERE body::int > 0

cases.name: a partition of a table with untrusted columns reads them too
a write whose WHERE reads an untrusted column
cases.sql: DELETE FROM logs WHERE msg IN (SELECT body FROM comments)

cases.name: a statement on unlabeled tables reads nothing untrusted
a denial reads nothing
a boolean over an untrusted column carries no content
cases.sql: SELECT id, body IS NULL AS empty FROM comments

cases.name: the whole row includes the untrusted column
a partition inherits its parent's labels
a redacted untrusted column carries no content
a partially revealed untrusted column still taints
untainted: secrets are readable
tainted: secrets are closed
tainted: a secret read hidden in a subquery
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM secrets)

cases.name: tainted: ordinary reads still run
tainted: an allowed write waits for a person
untainted: the same write runs
copying untrusted content into an unlabeled column taints
cases.sql: INSERT INTO logs (msg) SELECT body FROM comments WHERE id = 1

cases.name: an UPDATE that stores untrusted content taints
cases.sql: UPDATE logs SET msg = (SELECT body FROM comments WHERE id = 1) WHERE id = 2

cases.name: a write that only filters on untrusted content doesn't
cases.sql: DELETE FROM logs WHERE msg IN (SELECT body FROM comments)

cases.name: two untrusted sources, each once, in order
cases.sql: SELECT c.body, e.payload, c.body AS again FROM comments c, events e

cases.name: an ordinary read doesn't depend on taint
a secret read hidden in a subquery depends on taint
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM secrets)

cases.name: reading a partition of a secret parent depends on taint
tainted: a partition of a secret parent is closed
reading the parent of a secret partition depends on taint
cases.origin: Value: protects=a parent's rows include a secret partition's, so the gateway asks for taint; fails_when=secretTouched drops its childrenOf check; why_new=only the parent-labeled and view paths had rows; seam=none

cases.name: tainted: the parent of a secret partition is closed
cases.origin: Value: protects=invariant 11, a tainted grant can't read a secret partition through its parent; fails_when=secretTouched drops its childrenOf check; why_new=no row covered it; seam=none

cases.name: reading a secret table through a view depends on taint
tainted: a view over a secret table is closed
tainted: copying a secret into a table denies rather than waits
cases.sql: INSERT INTO logs (msg) SELECT value FROM secrets WHERE id = 1

cases.name: a held class is the cause, tainted or not
a held write that reads a secret table depends on taint
cases.sql: INSERT INTO logs (msg) SELECT value FROM secrets WHERE id = 1
cases.origin: Value: protects=a class-held write that reads a secret table still asks for taint, so a tainted grant can't file a copy of secrets; fails_when=decide() returns dependsOnTaint false for every class hold; why_new=only the false case had a row; seam=none

cases.name: tainted: a held write that reads a secret table is denied, not held
cases.sql: INSERT INTO logs (msg) SELECT value FROM secrets WHERE id = 1

cases.name: a held class without taint
a held write that stores untrusted content names its source
cases.sql: INSERT INTO logs (msg) SELECT body FROM comments WHERE id = 1

cases.name: a denial never depends on taint
